item.title: Shortcuts suck - just do the work
item.description: Founders always have the urge to find shortcuts around things. That’s actually a strong sign of entrepreneurial spirit. But, it’s only a skill, just like any other skill. It can’t be used to get around everything in entrepreneurship.
